modules.name: app-router
modules.purpose: Defines Next.js App Router shell, localized routing, root redirect, SEO system routes and global layout composition.

business_rules.description: Root path redirects to Ukrainian locale /uk.
Only uk and ru are accepted locales.
Locale prefix is always required.
Staging, localhost and vercel.app deployments are disallowed in robots.
Sitemap dynamic product entries are capped at 200 and category entries at 50.

algorithms.name: robots staging detection
algorithms.description: Classifies deployment as staging if site URL contains test.elektronom.com.ua, localhost or vercel.app.

algorithms.name: sitemap locale expansion
algorithms.description: Expands static, product and category routes across uk and ru locales.

modules.name: i18n-routing
modules.purpose: Provides Ukrainian/Russian locale routing, message loading, localized links, locale switching and breadcrumb URL generation.

functions.name: switchLocale
functions.returns: string pathname with replaced locale segment

business_rules.description: Only uk and ru are valid storefront locales.
All localized public routes use an always-present locale prefix.
Breadcrumb item URLs are expected to be non-localized paths because Breadcrumbs prefixes locale itself.
Ukrainian and Russian message catalogs currently have identical key sets.

algorithms.name: locale validation and message import
algorithms.description: Validates request locale before dynamically importing the matching message JSON file.

algorithms.name: locale switcher
algorithms.description: Replaces the first pathname segment with the other locale, but does not preserve query strings.

algorithms.name: breadcrumb URL composition
algorithms.description: Prefixes every breadcrumb URL with the active locale and builds Schema.org BreadcrumbList items.

modules.name: auth
modules.purpose: Authenticates users through credentials and OAuth, enriches JWT/session with roles, registers users and guards account/admin routes.

functions.name: session callback
functions.returns: session with user id and role

business_rules.description: NextAuth uses JWT session strategy.
OAuth providers are enabled only when both ID and secret are present.
Credentials login requires a stored password hash and bcrypt match.
Admin routes require role ADMIN.
New users are created with default CUSTOMER role.

algorithms.name: credentials verification
algorithms.description: Validates credentials, loads user by email, checks password hash with bcrypt and returns a role-bearing user payload.

algorithms.name: JWT/session role projection
algorithms.description: Copies id and role from authenticated user into JWT and then into session.

algorithms.name: registration auto-login
algorithms.description: Creates a password user and immediately attempts credentials sign-in from the client.

modules.name: catalog
modules.purpose: Implements catalog hub and category product listings with filters, sorting, view mode and pagination.

business_rules.description: Category listing only displays active products in active categories.
Category page nominal page size is 12.
Filtered product query defaults to page size 24 if pageSize is not supplied.
Filter changes reset pagination to page 1.

algorithms.name: search param parsing
algorithms.description: Converts URL search parameters into ActiveFilters, but currently does not split comma-separated arrays and expects inStock=true.

algorithms.name: filtered product query
algorithms.description: Builds a Prisma where clause for category, brand, price and stock, then performs findMany and count in parallel.

algorithms.name: category tree construction
algorithms.description: Builds nested category nodes from a flat category result set.

algorithms.name: pagination window
algorithms.description: Computes page buttons with ellipsis for large result sets.

modules.name: product-page
modules.purpose: Renders product detail pages with SEO metadata, Product JSON-LD, image gallery/lightbox, price and stock controls, quantity breaks, characteristics, description, reviews, same-series products and related products.

functions.name: generateStaticParams
functions.returns: top 1000 active product params expanded across locales

business_rules.description: Product pages are pre-generated for top 1000 active products per locale.
Product detail pages only load active products.
Quantity stepper maximum is the current product stock.
Quantity price breaks come from JSONB attributes.qty_breaks.
Same-series products currently mean same category and brand, with category-only fallback.
Related products are other active products from the same category.

algorithms.name: product static param expansion
algorithms.description: Queries active product slugs and expands each slug across uk and ru route params.

algorithms.name: quantity break price table
algorithms.description: Converts JSON quantity tiers into discounted unit prices.

algorithms.name: gallery carousel and lightbox navigation
algorithms.description: Uses client state with wraparound previous/next, Escape close and swipe gestures.

algorithms.name: review summary
algorithms.description: Calculates average rating, star breakdown and simple all/positive/negative filters.
algorithms.confidence: confirmed but blocked by syntax error

algorithms.name: product schema generation
algorithms.description: Builds Schema.org Product/Offer/AggregateRating JSON-LD from product detail data.

modules.name: cart
modules.purpose: Manages guest and authenticated cart state, cart mutations, cart drawer, full cart page, header badge and add-to-cart controls.

business_rules.description: Guest carts are stored in the HTTP-only cart cookie for 30 days.
Authenticated carts are stored in cart_items with a unique user/product row.
Quantity mutations are capped to integer range 0/1 through 99 by Zod schemas.
Guest cart is merged into DB cart on authenticated cart reads.
Product stock is checked before add and update quantity actions.
Zustand stores only drawer UI state and not cart business data.

algorithms.name: guest cookie parsing
algorithms.description: Parses cart cookie JSON and structurally filters productId/quantity items.

algorithms.name: guest-to-DB cart merge
algorithms.description: Moves cookie lines into authenticated cart rows inside a Prisma transaction and clears cookie afterwards.

algorithms.name: cart DTO projection
algorithms.description: Maps product/cart records into UI-ready CartItem DTOs with localized name, price, image and stock state.

algorithms.name: stock capping
algorithms.description: Caps add, merge and UI stepper quantities by product stock and max quantity 99.

algorithms.name: drawer lifecycle
algorithms.description: Opens drawer through Zustand, loads cart on open and closes with Escape/backdrop.

modules.name: checkout-orders
modules.purpose: Turns cart contents into persisted orders, validates checkout input, decrements product stock, creates order snapshots, clears carts and renders order success/account order views.

functions.name: CheckoutPage
functions.returns: checkout page or redirect to cart

functions.name: CheckoutForm.handleSubmit
functions.returns: createOrder side effect and router redirect

business_rules.description: Checkout with empty cart redirects to cart.
Order number format is ORD-YYYY-NNNNN.
Stock decrement uses updateMany with stock >= quantity to prevent negative stock.
Authenticated cart cleanup is inside the order transaction.
Order success route loads order summary by public order number.

algorithms.name: order total calculation
algorithms.description: Sums current product DB prices multiplied by cart quantities; shipping and discount are currently zero.

algorithms.name: negative stock prevention
algorithms.description: Each product stock decrement is guarded by updateMany where stock is at least requested quantity.

algorithms.name: concurrent order numbering
algorithms.description: Uses yearly OrderCounter upsert with increment to generate unique sequential order numbers.

algorithms.name: order snapshotting
algorithms.description: Copies localized product name, SKU, image and price into order item JSON snapshot.

algorithms.name: account order pagination
algorithms.description: Paginated query implementation exists in src/queries/orders.ts, though current account action uses an unpaginated query.

modules.name: account
modules.purpose: Protects customer account pages and renders personal cabinet order history, order detail, profile display, wishlist and sign-out.

functions.name: updateProfile
functions.confidence: confirmed but not wired to current UI

functions.name: changePassword
functions.confidence: confirmed but not wired to current UI

business_rules.description: Account routes require an authenticated session.
Unauthenticated account requests redirect to login with callback to orders.
Order detail is only returned when the order belongs to the current user.
Wishlist reads and writes are scoped to the current session user.
OAuth-only accounts cannot change password through changePassword().

algorithms.name: account route guard
algorithms.description: Validates locale and session before rendering nested account pages.

algorithms.name: order ownership check
algorithms.description: Loads by order number and rejects if order.userId differs from the current user.

algorithms.name: wishlist projection
algorithms.description: Loads current user's wishlist rows with nested product display projection.

algorithms.name: password change
algorithms.description: Validates current password with bcrypt before storing a new hash.

modules.name: search
modules.purpose: Provides localized product search through header autocomplete, full search page, Algolia search/index helpers and Prisma fallback search.

business_rules.description: Full search page only executes search for queries with length at least 2.
Header autocomplete executes search for any non-empty debounced query.
Algolia indices are locale-specific: products_uk and products_ru.
Missing Algolia credentials fall back to Prisma search or skip sync.
Prisma fallback searches localized product name and SKU only.

algorithms.name: debounce search
algorithms.description: Delays search execution by 300 ms after input changes.

algorithms.name: Algolia-first fallback search
algorithms.description: Uses Algolia when configured and falls back to Prisma search on missing credentials or errors.

algorithms.name: index sync fan-out
algorithms.description: Writes or deletes a product across uk and ru Algolia indices.

algorithms.name: fallback contains search
algorithms.description: Uses Prisma contains filters on localized translation name and SKU.

business_rules.description: Admin dashboard requires exact ADMIN role; MANAGER is not accepted.
Auth and permission failures redirect to the localized login page with admin callbackUrl.
Dashboard latest order list is limited to five rows with explicit select fields.
Admin page metadata is noindex/nofollow.

algorithms.name: admin role guard
algorithms.description: Checks current session and allows only users with role ADMIN.

algorithms.name: dashboard aggregate query
algorithms.description: Runs order/user/product counts and latest-orders query in parallel.

algorithms.name: admin customer snapshot display
algorithms.description: Casts order customerData JSON into firstName/lastName display text.

business_rules.description: Tailwind CSS v4 config lives in globals.css via @theme; no tailwind.config.ts/js exists.
Design radius scale is 4/6/8 px, but app uses many rounded-2xl/4xl classes.
Protocol bans inline styles, but app/components contain 344 style={{...}} occurrences.
UI primitives reference shadcn token names not declared in the Elektronom @theme.

algorithms.name: token-to-utility mapping
algorithms.description: Tailwind v4 @theme inline maps CSS variables to utilities.

algorithms.name: UI primitive variant composition
algorithms.description: class-variance-authority maps variant/size props to utility classes.

algorithms.name: design cleanup order
algorithms.description: Repair text, align primitive tokens, remove inline styles, normalize radius, then run visual QA.

business_rules.description: AGENTS.md and MASTER_CONTEXT v1_02.md are the first protocol files to read before implementation.
Original Antigravity TZ files are historical reference only, not active implementation plan.
Old Prisma/Zustand/Master v1.2 references are superseded by MASTER v1.3 / Prisma 7 / Zustand 5.
Developer reports must list changed files, closed TZ points, checks and residual risks.

algorithms.name: documentation reading order
algorithms.description: AGENTS -> MASTER -> docs/tz README -> active TZ docs -> coverage matrix/originals if needed.

algorithms.name: original coverage mapping
algorithms.description: Maps each original TZ block into active working TZ files or historical archive.

algorithms.name: documentation curation order
algorithms.description: Fix MASTER contradictions, archive stale snapshots, update working TZs with Reversa findings, then maintain current next actions.
